effect.name: CIELab (Switch)
effect.description: Shader allows changing luminance, a* and b*.
effect.author: Foxioo

parameter.name: /* Foxioo's CIELab (Switch) Shader | 2026.08.20 */
parameter.description: Shader allows changing luminance, a* and b*.

parameter.name: Blending Mode
parameter.description: This variable determines what the base should be. Setting it to 0 sets the base as the texture of the object on which the effect is applied, and setting it to 1 sets this as the background.

parameter.name: Mixing
parameter.description: This variable is responsible for the visibility of the effect.

parameter.name: Luminance
parameter.description: This variable changes the color Luminance. (Range from 0 to 100)

parameter.name: A*
parameter.description: This variable changes (A* from LAB). (Range from -128 to 127)

parameter.name: B*
parameter.description: This variable changes (B* from LAB). (Range from -128 to 127)
